verdict.rationale: Account data portability is a fair question for a SaaS API platform like Channel3, so the axis applies. The pack never documents a way to export a user's own account data, such as sales, attribution records, price-tracking subscriptions or usage, nor any off-boarding path. CLI output formatting and structured product-catalog responses are adjacent features, not a user-data export capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
